entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: The input encodes reduction of an aromatic nitro substituent (Ar–NO2) to the corresponding aniline (Ar–NH2) on a benzothiazole-like fused heteroaromatic scaffold.
The product is represented approximately as Nc1ccc2ncsc2c1.

entities.name: SnCl2 nitro reduction
observations: Tin(II) chloride (SnCl2) is directly supported for reducing the aromatic nitro group to an amino group.
Reported workup components include HCl, NH4OH, or NaOH; these are acidic reduction and aqueous/base workup conditions rather than necessarily the reducing reagent itself.

entities.name: Alternative nitro reductions
observations: Plausible standard alternatives include H2/Pd-C, PtO2, Raney Ni, Fe/NH4Cl, Fe/HCl, Zn/NH4Cl, Zn/AcOH, and Sn/HCl.
These alternatives were not directly documented in the returned records; SnCl2 is the database-supported choice.
